computer_v1.html.name: Original 8 Bit Computer
computer_v1.html.desc: An 8-bit stack-based computer processor designed to support programming in Reverse Polish Notation (RPN). I got the idea for this from my 1989 HP 48SX calculator which also uses RPN. It has: 64k of heap memory, 64k x 16 bit instruction flash, a 32 x 32 display, a hardware call stack, and basic binary operations.

computer_v2.html.name: Computer V2
computer_v2.html.desc: A fully backwards-compatible version of my first computer, this design has much better performance and more features. I have not started building it yet because of the cost, however I have a working simulation.
